Prior to activation of your new Singtel-UOB Visa Signature Card, your existing Singtel-UOB Visa Platinum Card digitized on your mobile payment wallet will not be affected and will be valid for use until its expiry date.

After the activation of your new Singtel-UOB Visa Signature Card, the card expiry date and CVV details in your mobile payment wallet will be automatically updated with the new expiry date and CVV of your new Singtel-UOB Visa Signature Card.
